note: Hidden text that is suspicious enough to say and not enough to touch the page. Every case here must produce exactly one verdict, at medium confidence, whose action is inform — a banner a person can read and dismiss, never an edit. This band is what ADR-0012 created, and until 2026-08-20 the corpus had no case in it: cancelling the two-tier rule outright left all 38 positives found and all 61 negatives silent, and reddened one hand-made unit test. Scope and limits: three of the four corroborating signals are represented — tool-invocation, sensitive-target, vocative. char-anomaly is absent because it has no reachable weak form: a lone zero-width character produces no signal at all, and a right-to-left override is strong and stands alone (both measured 2026-08-20). Both languages are present on purpose; a band certified in one language is a band uncertified in the other.
